title: macrocnemum dissimiliflorum
intro: Macrocnemum dissimiliflorum, commonly known as the "Cocha" or "Cocha root," is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and treating fever. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Macrocnemum dissimiliflorum, including flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
